title: A pulsing star

data.source: NASA Kepler long-cadence light curves of V1154 Cygni (KIC 7548061), quarters 0 to 17, from the Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST)

prediction: If each beat is timed from the beat before, the correlation between one beat's length and the next is above -0.25 (P1), and the mean squared change in lateness over 16 beats is at least 8 times that over 1 beat (P2).
baseline: A clock with a shaky hand (correlation -0.5, no growth) and a pure pile-up of errors (correlation 0, growth 16 times).
why: One test came out each way. Neighbouring beats were nearer to unrelated than to give-and-take, but the lateness did not wander far enough for a pure pile-up. The star looks like a steady clock underneath with a small wandering on top.
